Attach Bio-data and all essential qualification and experience certificates to the application form.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIIMS/JDH/CMFM/NKH-Res./117 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AIIMS Jodhpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 09:30 AM on 02-12-2026 will not be entertained for interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of 6 months, extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate Purely temporary/contractual, co-terminus with the project No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project Contract service confers no right for further assignment or regular appointment in the institute

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Jodhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (only if a large number of eligible applications are received) Walk-in Interview A written examination will be conducted if a large number of eligible applications are received Walk-in interview on 02-12-2026; reporting closes at 09:30 AM

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience All essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form No Objection Certificate (for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertakings)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given in the notice (Format for Application). Attach Bio-data and all essential qualification and experience certificates to the application form. Report in person on 02-12-2026 between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM at Room No. 211, Dept. of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, 2nd Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Jodhpur. Submit the filled application and Bio-data on the day of the walk-in interview. Bring all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of age, qualification and experience documents.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date Application without essential qualification and experience certificates will be considered incomplete The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications and skill set

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Room No. 211, Dept. of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, 2nd Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on case to case basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67000 per month + 20% HRA = Rs. 80,400 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BAMS with Post Graduate Degree in Relevant Subject with one-year experience.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting after 09:30 AM on 02-12-2026 will not be entertained for interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination (only if a large number of eligible applications are received). Walk-in Interview. A written examination will be conducted if a large number of eligible applications are received. Walk-in interview on 02-12-2026; reporting closes at 09:30 AM.
